model_source: AirCaps Live 1 integration guide (internal preview, shared by AirCaps)

pricing.billing_basis: duration of audio streamed (finished reports billed_ms equal to audio_ms)

protocol_caveat: Each session first asks the HTTPS endpoint for its WebSocket address, which must be wss on *.aircaps.ai, and the lookup's model must match. start requests the model with 16 kHz mono pcm_s16le and no end-of-turn detection; ready echoes the model and language, and a different echo fails the attempt. Every transcript message holds the whole session text; its first final_chars characters are settled and is_final settles all of it, so settled text shrinking or changing marks the reconstruction unsupported. finalize at speech end returns a final at once when there is speech but gets no reply when there is none, so there is no finalize acknowledgment; completion is finished after finish, which follows a last final. Without finalize the server also settles text by itself about every 20 seconds of audio. Such a server-settled final can carry an older, shorter copy of text already settled, and the next message restores the full text; that stale final is skipped, not counted as a failure, and is counted from the raw events for the report. Interim text arrives about once a second. The preview account allows one concurrent session.
